title: Evaluation Engineer
location: Muzzafarpur, Jamshedpur, Delhi, Karnal, Rewari, Sonipat, Guntur, Hubli, Hyderabad, Pune, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Gurgaon, Chandigarh, Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Bareilly, Nagpur, Mangalore, Bhopal, Kolhapur, Guwahati, Rudrapur, Sangli, Haldwani, Solapur, Godhra, Bhilwara, Saharanpur, Moradabad, Nadiad, Gandhidham, Pathanamthitta, Jalandhar, Kalaburagi (gulbarga), Chengalpattu, Budaun
jobDescription:
Evaluation Engineer JD

What drives us?
A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We're building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?
  • Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections at customer sites, adhering to the highest standards of productivity and precision.
  • Kick off daily operations with the first inspection by 9:00 AM sharp.
  • Efficiently manage communications, ensuring all client interactions happen within specified timelines.
  • Complete detailed reports and document findings in our proprietary system for all inspections conducted within allocated time slots.
  • Navigate a daily route covering a 35-45 km radius, executing an average of 6 vehicle inspections per day.


Who are we looking for?
  • A motivated professional with a robust work ethic, ready to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • An owner of a two-wheeler with adeptness in operating manual and automatic vehicles.
  • A holder of a valid driver's licence.
  • Possess excellent observational, analytical, and reporting skills.
  • Skilled in communication and interpersonal interactions, capable of delivering high-quality customer service.

title: Company Secretary
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at CARS24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • IPO Readiness & Execution - Drive and manage the end-to-end IPO process, ensuring adherence to SEBI (ICDR) regulations and stock exchange listing requirements. Coordinate with investment bankers, legal counsels, auditors, and regulatory authorities to facilitate smooth IPO execution. Assist in drafting the Red Herring Prospectus (RHP), Offer Documents, and related regulatory filings. Oversee due diligence processes, ensuring all statutory disclosures and compliance requirements are met. Manage pre-IPO restructuring, ESOP structuring, and corporate governance frameworks to align with listing requirements.

  • Corporate Governance & Regulatory Compliance - Ensure adherence to Companies Act, SEBI LODR (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), and other applicable regulations. Organize and manage board meetings, general meetings, and committee meetings, including preparation of agendas, minutes, and resolutions. Ensure timely submission of periodic disclosures, returns, and filings with SEBI, MCA, and stock exchanges. Maintain statutory records and registers as per the Companies Act and listing requirements. Implement best practices in corporate governance, aligning with shareholder interests and regulatory expectations.

  • Post-Listing Compliance & Stakeholder Management - Ensure continuous compliance with listing regulations, insider trading guidelines, and corporate governance norms post-IPO. Manage investor relations by coordinating with shareholders, analysts, and regulators on disclosures and company performance. Handle secretarial audits, compliance certifications, and statutory reporting as per listing guidelines. Monitor evolving regulatory frameworks and advise leadership on necessary compliance adjustments.

Who are we looking for?

  • You're the one if you have: Minimum Experience: 6-8 years in corporate secretarial roles, with significant exposure to IPOs, SEBI regulations, and listing compliances. Qualification: Qualified Company Secretary (CS) from ICSI. Additional legal or finance qualifications (LLB, CFA, CA) are a plus.

  • Required Skills: IPO & Listing Expertise: Proven experience in managing IPO processes, SEBI (ICDR) compliance, and stock exchange regulations.

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Companies Act, SEBI LODR, Insider Trading Regulations, and FEMA. Corporate Governance: Experience in board governance, shareholder management, and statutory compliance.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate effectively with regulators, investors, legal advisors, and auditors.

  • Documentation & Reporting: Expertise in preparing regulatory filings, board resolutions, and compliance reports.

  • Attention to Detail: High accuracy in managing legal and regulatory documentation.

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulations and provide actionable solutions.

Lead the management and analysis of the P&L statement, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with financial objectives and targets.

    Proficiency in advanced Excel and financial modeling

title: Business Analyst
jobDescription:
You will be a core builder of Cars24's AI analytics infrastructure. This is not a maintenance role — you will design, build, and deploy AI agents, extend our Power BI semantic layer, optimize our data pipelines, and directly impact decisions made by analysts, business unit heads, and the CEO.

If you have ever wanted to build something that an entire org uses every day — this is it.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

AI Agent Development

  • Build and maintain our Claude-powered Slack analytics bot (multi-turn, tool-calling, SQL-generating agents)

  • Extend agent capabilities: anomaly detection, proactive morning briefings, multi-agent orchestration

  • Reduce hallucination/wrong-answer rate to <5% — own the quality bar

  • Connect agents to Star Rocks via XMLA and direct SQL interfaces

Power BI & Semantic Layer

  • Build and extend DAX measures on Microsoft Fabric F64

  • Debug complex DAX (USERELATIONSHIP, CALCULATE context, time intelligence)

  • Document new measures with the rigor of a product engineer

  • Inject semantic layer definitions into agent system prompts for governed, accurate answers

Data Engineering

  • Write production-grade SQL on Snowflake / Star Rocks (CTEs, window functions, complex joins)

  • Contribute to dbt gold layer models and YAML metric definitions

  • Automate insight generation — eliminate Google Sheets dependencies across your scope

Insight & Impact

  • Deliver minimum 3 deep insights per quarter that lead to stakeholder action

  • Visit hubs, listen to CJ calls, connect with customers — get grounded in the business

  • Think as a Growth Partner, not a data provider


SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS


✅ Must Have

❌ Red Flags

Python (5+ years, production use)

Google Sheets workarounds (we are eliminating these)

SQL — complex queries, optimization

Drag-and-drop only BI usage

LLM API integration (Anthropic / Open AI)

'AI experience' = only prompting Chat GPT

Built at least one agent/bot / tool-calling system

Needs hand-holding on data model design

Power BI & DAX (intermediate to advanced)

Reactive mindset — waits for tasks, doesn't find problems

Understands semantic layers & metric governance

Can't explain CALCULATE context in DAX

Team leadership — has led or mentored analysts


Strong IC — can build end-to-end independently



BONUS SKILLS (WILL STAND OUT)

  • Experience with Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, or Auto Gen

  • XMLA or Power BI REST API integration

  • dbt (models, tests, YAML metric definitions)

  • Fast API for wrapping AI agents as web services

  • Star Rocks or Snowflake query optimization

  • Hex, Thought Spot, or other modern BI tooling


HIRING TEAM: KEY INTERVIEW QUESTIONS

Use these 3 questions to filter real builders from resume-padders:


Q1

"Walk me through how you'd build an agent that answers business questions from a database — what are the failure modes and how do you handle them?"

Tests: agent thinking, hallucination awareness, system design

Q2

"A DAX measure using USERELATIONSHIP is returning wrong results. Walk me through how you debug it."

Tests: real Power BI depth vs surface-level knowledge

Q3

"We have a 'City' column with an 'ALL' row (total) and 17 individual cities. Write a SQL query that computes a 'Rest of Cities' row — ALL minus the 17 cities — without double-counting."

Tests: real SQL thinking under business constraints


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Work on a genuinely AI-first analytics stack — not a future plan, a present reality

  • Direct impact: your agents will be used by 98 analysts and business leaders daily

  • Growth Partner Program — quarterly cash rewards for top performers

  • Access to Microsoft Fabric F64, Snowflake, Claude API, and modern tooling

  • Mentorship from a Head of Analytics building a world-class org from scratch

  • Hybrid working — Gurugram HQ with flexibility


GROWTH PARTNER PROGRAM

This role is eligible for the CARS24 Growth Partner Program. Top 3 performers each quarter — rated across AI-first delivery, automation, insight quality, and business impact — receive a cash reward. This is not a bonus scheme. It is a recognition that the best analysts create business outcomes, not just reports.


HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a brief note (max 200 words) answering this: "Describe one agent or automated system you have built — what problem did it solve, and what broke first?"

Applications without this note will not be reviewed. We care about builders.


AI-First. No Jugaad. No GSheets. Just Impact.

title: Builder
jobDescription:
Designation: Builder

What will you drive?

  • Strategic Leadership: Lead and execute business strategies to scale operations, improve efficiencies, and drive growth. Work closely with senior leadership to identify opportunities and challenges, delivering data-driven solutions that align with CARS24's vision.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product, marketing, operations, and technology teams to ensure smooth execution of business strategies and operational improvements. Foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Operational Excellence: Oversee day-to-day business functions, ensuring all teams meet performance and revenue targets. Optimize processes, identify bottlenecks, and implement best practices across business units.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Build and mentor high-performing teams. Lead by example, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. Develop the skills of your team members through training, feedback, and development plans.

    Customer-Centric Mindset: Ensure all initiatives are driven by a deep understanding of customer needs and feedback. Strive to enhance the customer journey, identifying pain points and driving improvement initiatives that make a tangible impact on customer satisfaction.

  • P &L Management: Take ownership of the business unit's P&L, ensuring cost-effective operations while driving revenue growth. Monitor financial performance, adjust forecasts, and implement corrective actions as needed.

  • Market Insights & Competitive Intelligence: Stay on top of market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities. Provide insights to the leadership team to drive CARS24's strategic direction and maintain a competitive edge.

Who are we looking for?

  • EDUCATION: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field. MBA or advanced business qualification is a plus.

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in business leadership, with at least 3-5 years in a senior management role, preferably in a fast-paced tech-driven environment.

  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated ability to successfully lead cross-functional teams, deliver measurable results, and drive business growth in a complex environment.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Comfortable using data to inform decisions and strategies.

  • Leadership & Team Development: Proven ability to manage, motivate, and develop teams. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a passion for fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.

  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in the automotive, e-commerce, or tech industry is a plus, but not mandatory. A keen understanding of digital transformation and consumer behavior is essential.
    Problem-Solving & Innovation: Ability to tackle challenges head-on with creative, out-of-the-box thinking. A focus on continuous improvement and driving operational efficiencies

title: Retail Associate
location: Faridabad, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Mumbai
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we're building at CARS24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We're building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • As a Retail Associate (RA), your daily goal is to reach a set number of leads and engage prospects with charm and persuasion.
  • We'll track your calling minutes to ensure every moment counts toward our success.
  • This role isn't just about showing up; it's about delivering results!
  • You'll have monthly targets that push your competitive spirit and test your negotiation skills. And there's more! You'll receive comprehensive training over 7 to 15 days, both in the classroom and on the job.
  • Our top-notch program prepares you to handle any challenge because at CARS24, we're committed to setting you up for success.
  • Get ready for incentives that revolve around hitting targets, scoring big on conversions, and turning every challenge into a victory lap.
  • It's not just about meeting goals; it's about surpassing them and reaping the rewards.

Who are we looking for?

  • Cruise into a full-time gig with 6 action-packed work days a week.
  • Don't worry; we've got your back with a weekday off to recharge those engines.
  • A disciplined enthusiast with strong negotiation skills with customers and regular follow up to win back leads.
  • Zoom in at 9:30 AM and coast through to 6:30 PM—because at CARS24, we're all about revving up during office hours.
  • Park yourself at our office by 10 AM sharp (maximum), with a dash of Punctuality and flexibility for those occasional extra laps around the track.
  • Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at CARS24, where every day is a drive towards success!

What drives us?

Imagine: a single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. ●As a Builder - Retail Associate, your daily goal is to reach a set number of leads and engage prospects with charm and persuasion.

jobDescription:

What will you drive?

Financial Reporting & Analysis:-

  • Prepare and analyse monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulations.

  • Provide detailed analysis of financial performance and identify trends.

Compliance & Audit:-

  • Ensure adherence to internal controls and financial policies.

  • Coordinate with external auditors for annual audits.

  • Fixed Asset register and Leases

  • Maintain compliance with tax regulations and corporate governance requirements.

Financial Strategy & Planning:-

  • Provide financial insights and strategic recommendations to senior management.

  • Assist in the development of financial plans and business strategies.

  • Evaluate investment opportunities and perform financial modelling.

Team Leadership:-

  • Lead and mentor the finance and accounts team.

  • Ensure continuous professional development and performance management.

  • Foster a culture of financial integrity and accountability.

Who are we looking for?

  • A qualified Chartered Accountant with minimum experience 3 years of experience in finance controllership and coordinating audits with Big4 firms.

  • Start-up experience would be preferred.

  • Should have team handling experience.

  • Strong background in establishing financial processes

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills

  • Proficiency in financial software (SAP HANA)

  • A team player with a positive attitude, resilience, and a customer-first approach.

jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Car Expertise: Utilise your thorough understanding of car makes, models, and mechanics to stay updated on industry trends and advancements.
  • Yard/Retail Store Inputs Management - Own up Inputs at your Yards/Retail stores, ensuring better conversion and satisfactory customer experience.
  • Vehicle Inspection and Valuation: Assess vehicle conditions to provide accurate valuations and identify any issues during inspections.
  • Customer Engagement: Reach out to customers visiting our Yards, present compelling selling propositions, and convince them to sell their vehicles at Cars24 quotes.
  • Mobile Specialist: Travelling as needed for customer meetings and inspections, providing hands-on support across different areas.
  • Travel: Occasionally travel for customer meetings, as well as for vehicle inspections, using your own two-wheeler for convenience.


Who are we looking for?

  • We are looking for a passionate and knowledgeable individual with experience in automotive retail or vehicle inspection.
  • The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of car makes, models, and mechanics, along with excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • You must have a valid 4-wheeler driving licence and be proficient in driving both automatic and manual cars.
  • Additionally, owning a two-wheeler for travel is required. If you are detail-oriented, results-driven, and eager to drive growth in a dynamic environment, we want to hear from you!
  • Your sitting can be either in one of our yards or remote location retail stores.

title: Builder - Finance
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Manager – Finance Operations is responsible for leading the end-to-end Finance Operations function for the Australia business, ensuring accurate, compliant, and efficient financial operations across the procure-to-pay, order-to- cash, and record-to-report cycles. The role leads a team of finance professionals, drives operational excellence, strengthens financial controls, partners with cross- functional stakeholders, and champions process automation and continuous improvement to support business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Australia Finance Operations team, providing direction, coaching, performance management, and resource planning to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Oversee end-to-end Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payments,
  • Revenue Accounting, Vendor Management, Customer Refunds, and Bank
  • Reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and adherence to defined SLAs.
  • Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including reconciliations, journal entries, balance sheet substantiation, accruals, and financial schedules.
  • Own revenue recognition and accounting for all key business streams, including B2B, B2C, Value Added Services (VAS), Freight Monetization, Vehicle Procurement, Logistics, and other finance operations.
  • Establish and strengthen financial controls, governance frameworks, SOPs, approval workflows, and compliance processes to ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
  • Partner with Business, Sales, Procurement, Operations, Product, Engineering, Treasury, Tax, Customer Experience, and Audit teams to resolve operational issues, improve financial processes, and support strategic business initiatives.
  • Drive finance transformation through automation, process optimization, system enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and control.
  • Act as the Finance SME for SAP HANA and integrated finance systems by supporting process enhancements, finance UAT, accounting validations, and system governance.
  • Monitor operational KPIs, identify process bottlenecks, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to improve operational performance and stakeholder experience.
  • Prepare and present MIS, dashboards, management reports, and operational insights to support decision-making and drive business performance.

Systems & Tools

  • SAP HANA, DMS, PIM, Hub Spot, Adyen, Westpac, Citi Bank, Microsoft Excel,
  • Google Workspace, Google Sheets, Slack, and workflow & automation platforms.

Key Success Metrics

  • Timely and accurate financial close.
  • Accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.
  • Compliance with internal controls, audit, and statutory requirements.
  • Payment and collection SLA adherence.
  • Reduction in manual effort through automation and process improvements.
  • Reconciliation accuracy and ageing management.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and issue resolution.
  • Team productivity, capability development, and engagement.
  • Continuous improvement in operational efficiency and process governance.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification.
  • 6–10+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Accounting, Shared Services, or Controllership, with proven experience managing teams.
  • Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Revenue Accounting, Financial Controls, ERP systems, and process automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage stakeholder relationships, drive operational excellence, and build scalable finance processes in a dynamic business environment

jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections at customer sites, adhering to the highest standards of productivity and precision.

  • Kick off daily operations with the first inspection by 9:00 AM sharp.

  • Efficiently manage communications, ensuring all client interactions happen within specified timelines.

  • Complete detailed reports and document findings in our proprietary system for all inspections conducted within allocated time slots.

  • Navigate a daily route covering a 35-45 km radius, executing an average of 6 vehicle inspections per day.

Who are we looking for?

  • A motivated professional with a robust work ethic, ready to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • An owner of a two-wheeler with adeptness in operating manual and automatic vehicles.

  • A holder of a valid driver's license.

  • Possess excellent observational, analytical, and reporting skills.

  • Skilled in communication and interpersonal interactions, capable of delivering high-quality customer service.

title: Builder - Car Advisor
location: New Delhi, Hyderabad, Noida, Chandigarh, Kolkata, Surat, Chennai, Lucknow, Bangalore, Delhi, Vishakhapatnam, Bhopal, Jaipur, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Pune, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore, Kochi, Patna, Indore, Faridabad, Visakhapatnam, Vadodara, Ghaziabad
jobDescription:
Job Description Te Join Us as a Car Advisor (Sales Associate)
Do you get excited every time you see a great car? Do you enjoy talking to people, building relationships, and helping customers make important decisions?

Whether you're a car enthusiast, a people person, or someone looking to build a rewarding career in sales, CARS24 is the place for you!

Who Can Apply?
Men & Women passionate about cars and customer service
Freshers with confidence and enthusiasm
Experienced sales professionals looking for fast career growth
Individuals who enjoy interacting with customers and delivering exceptional experiences

What You'll Do
Be the Face of CARS24
Welcome and engage customers visiting our retail showrooms.
Understand customer requirements and help them find their perfect car.
Drive Sales Success
Guide customers through the complete car-buying journey.
Build trust and create a transparent, hassle-free buying experience.
Bring Cars to Life
Conduct exciting test drives and showcase vehicle features.
Share insights on vehicle specifications, benefits, and pricing.
Help Customers Own Their Dream Car
Explain financing and payment options.
Support customers with documentation and purchase formalities.
Build Lasting Relationships
Follow up with customers and create memorable experiences that drive referrals and repeat business.
What We're Looking For
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Customer-first mindset and positive attitude
Passion for cars and the automotive industry
Confidence in sales, negotiation, and relationship building
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Valid driving license preferred
What's In It For You?
✨ Attractive Salary + Incentives
✨ Professional Training & Development
✨ Fast-Track Career Growth Opportunities
✨ Opportunity to Work with India's Leading Auto-Tech Company
✨ Dynamic, High-Energy Work Environment
✨ Learn, Grow, and Build a Long-Term Career in Automotive Retail

Ready to Accelerate Your Career?
If cars excite you, customers inspire you, and success motivates you, we would love to meet you!

jobDescription:
Job Description Tem Job Title: Workshop Service Manager (WSM)

Location: Pan India

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and technically sound Workshop Service Manager to manage workshop operations, vehicle inspections, quality checks, and service excellence across our refurbishment network. The ideal candidate should have strong automobile knowledge, leadership skills, and the ability to drive operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end workshop operations and vehicle inspections.
Ensure quality checks and adherence to refurbishment standards.
Monitor inventory, spare parts, and workshop resources.
Supervise technicians and ensure timely completion of work.
Drive process efficiency, productivity, and safety compliance.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to improve turnaround time.
Maintain operational reports and performance metrics.
Ensure customer and business service standards are consistently met.
Eligibility Criteria
Minimum 2+ years of experience in automobile service, workshop operations, vehicle inspections, or refurbishment.
Strong technical knowledge of cars and automotive systems.
Experience in vehicle inspection and quality assessment.
Own 2-wheeler (Mandatory).
Valid 2W & 4W Driving License.
Ability to drive both manual and automatic cars.
Comfortable with fieldwork and local travel.
Good communication and team management skills.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Up to ₹4.5 LPA (based on experience and interview performance).
Performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to work with one of India's leading auto-tech companies.
Career growth and learning opportunities.

6 Days Working
Weekend availability required

title: Builder - Listing
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • This role involves achieving defined listing targets.

  • Guide customers looking to sell their cars by helping them list their vehicles on the portal.

  • Coordinate with potential buyers to facilitate smooth negotiations and deal closures.

  • Focus on maximizing conversions to meet targets and contribute to revenue generation for the company.

  • Provide customers with information about our products and services through effective and engaging communication.

  • Handle both inbound and outbound calls to address customer inquiries and resolve their issues promptly.

  • Understand customer needs thoroughly and offer suitable solutions to their queries.

  • Build strong rapport with customers to ensure a seamless and satisfying experience.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and transactions in the system.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns and deliver a smooth journey.

  • Meet daily and monthly targets related to call handling, customer engagement, and successful conversions.

  • Stay consistently updated on product features and market trends to deliver accurate, relevant, and compelling information to customers.

Who are we looking for?

  • A dynamic individual with 0–10 years of experience in customer support, telecalling, inside sales, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong ability to build trust and rapport over calls.

  • A proactive problem-solver who can quickly understand customer needs and offer effective, solution-oriented responses.

  • An individual who is comfortable managing payment-related discussions and can ensure a smooth, transparent, and satisfactory customer journey.

  • Someone with a target-driven mindset , capable of working in a fast-paced environment and consistently achieving daily and monthly conversion goals.

  • A team player with a positive attitude, resilience, and a customer-first approach.

  • Proficiency in regional languages will be an added advantage to connect better with a diverse customer base.

jobDescription:
Job Title: Workshop Service Manager (WSM)

Location: Pan India

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and technically sound Workshop Service Manager to manage workshop operations, vehicle inspections, quality checks, and service excellence across our refurbishment network. The ideal candidate should have strong automobile knowledge, leadership skills, and the ability to drive operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end workshop operations and vehicle inspections.
Ensure quality checks and adherence to refurbishment standards.
Monitor inventory, spare parts, and workshop resources.
Supervise technicians and ensure timely completion of work.
Drive process efficiency, productivity, and safety compliance.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to improve turnaround time.
Maintain operational reports and performance metrics.
Ensure customer and business service standards are consistently met.
Eligibility Criteria
Minimum 2+ years of experience in automobile service, workshop operations, vehicle inspections, or refurbishment.
Strong technical knowledge of cars and automotive systems.
Experience in vehicle inspection and quality assessment.
Own 2-wheeler (Mandatory).
Valid 2W & 4W Driving License.
Ability to drive both manual and automatic cars.
Comfortable with fieldwork and local travel.
Good communication and team management skills.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Up to ₹4.5 LPA (based on experience and interview performance).
Performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to work with one of India's leading auto-tech companies.
Career growth and learning opportunities.
Working Details
6 Days Working
Weekend availability required
Flexible to travel as per business requirements

title: Builder - Closure
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • This role involves achieving defined conversion targets.

  • Guide customers looking to buy cars by helping them explore the listed vehicles on the portal.

  • Coordinate with potential buyers to facilitate smooth negotiations and deal closures.

  • Focus on maximizing conversions to meet targets and contribute to revenue generation for the company.

  • Provide customers with information about our products and services through effective and engaging communication.

  • Handle both inbound and outbound calls to address customer inquiries and resolve their issues promptly.

  • Understand customer needs thoroughly and offer suitable solutions to their queries.

  • Build strong rapport with customers to ensure a seamless and satisfying experience.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and transactions in the system.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns and deliver a smooth journey.

  • Meet daily and monthly targets related to call handling, customer engagement, and successful conversions.

  • Stay consistently updated on product features and market trends to deliver accurate, relevant, and compelling information to customers.

Who are we looking for?

  • A dynamic individual with 0–10 years of experience in customer support, tele-calling, inside sales, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong ability to build trust and rapport over calls.

  • A proactive problem-solver who can quickly understand customer needs and offer effective, solution-oriented responses.

  • An individual who is comfortable managing payment-related discussions and can ensure a smooth, transparent, and satisfactory customer journey.

  • Someone with a target-driven mindset , capable of working in a fast-paced environment and consistently achieving daily and monthly conversion goals.

  • A team player with a positive attitude, resilience, and a customer-first approach.

  • Proficiency in regional languages will be an added advantage to connect better with a diverse customer base.

jobDescription:
Job Title: WSM Team Lead

Location: Pan India
Experience: 3+ Years
CTC: As per company standards

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented WSM Team Lead to manage and guide a team of Workshop Service Managers. The role involves driving refurbishment operations, ensuring quality standards, monitoring team performance, and achieving business targets across assigned locations.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage a team of WSMs across assigned hubs.
Monitor daily refurbishment and inspection operations.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and SOPs.
Track team productivity, turnaround time, and target achievement.
Conduct regular audits and provide feedback for process improvement.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for smooth operations.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and development of team members.
Resolve operational challenges and escalate critical issues when required.
Prepare and share performance reports and business updates.

Requirements
Minimum 3+ years of experience in Automobile Service, Workshop Operations, Refurbishment, or Team Handling.
Strong leadership and people management skills.
Good understanding of vehicle inspection and refurbishment processes.
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Valid Driving License mandatory.
Willingness to travel as per business requirements.

title: Builder - Collections
jobDescription:
What will you drive?

  • Manage the Hard Collections program, including Field Visits, Repossessions, Suraksha (Car Liquidation), Loss on Sale (LOS), and Write-Off portfolio.
  • Collaborate with Business Finance and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure smooth operations and strategy alignment.
  • Prepare, manage, and publish performance dashboards and MIS reports in coordination with the Department Head.
  • Drive digital recovery initiatives such as calling campaigns and digital communication to improve collections.
  • Execute settlement drives and recovery initiatives in coordination with the Department Head.
  • Monitor recovery performance and share regular reports and insights with stakeholders.
  • Create, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for departmental processes.
  • Work closely with the Hard Collections and Skip Tracing teams to improve customer traceability and recovery rates.
  • Monitor payment instruments and collection processes to ensure operational efficiency and accuracy.
  • Lead projects focused on portfolio performance, recovery optimization, and operational excellence.
  • Coordinate with Collections, Finance, Business Finance, and Customer Experience (Ce X) teams for seamless execution.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support implementation of automation and operational enhancements.
  • Ensure all recovery activities comply with company policies, regulatory guidelines, and legal requirements.

Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.Tech) or an equivalent qualification; MBA is preferred.
  • 2–4 years of experience in Collections & Recoveries within the NBFC or Banking sector.
  • Prior experience in debt management or consulting within the collections domain will be an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and research skills.
  • Good understanding of recovery processes, repossession, liquidation, and portfolio management.
  • Knowledge of compliance, legal, and regulatory requirements related to loan recovery.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Proficient in MS Excel, MIS reporting, and data analysis.
  • Strong communication, planning, and project management skills.
  • Ability to drive process improvements and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

title: Builder - Procurement Partner
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We're building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

As a Builder-Procurement Partner you will:

  • Implementing and driving sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets and goals.
  • Leading, mentoring, and motivating a team of sales representatives to ensure they achieve individual and team objectives.
  • Monitoring and evaluating the performance of team members, providing regular feedback, coaching, and training to enhance their skills and productivity.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Preparing and presenting regular sales reports and forecasts to senior management, analyzing sales data to identify trends and opportunities for growth.
  • Identifying and implementing process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness within the sales team.
  • Collaborating with other departments such as marketing, product development, and customer support to align sales strategies with overall business goals.
  • Keeping abreast of industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to inform sales strategies and tactics.

Who are we looking for?

Proven experience in a sales leadership role, with a track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets. Experience in automobile is a plus. Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a sales team to achieve high performance. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with clients, team members, and other stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse sales data and market trends to inform strategic decisions. A customer-centric approach, with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building long-term relationships. The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and adapt to changing priorities and business needs. A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.

What drives us?

We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • Seamless RC Transfers Manage end-to-end RC transfer processes, ensuring timely and accurate documentation. Coordinate with RTOs, customers, and teams to maintain compliance with regulations. Keep records updated for audits and transparency.

  • Efficient Team Management Lead and supervise teams across multiple cities, ensuring adherence to timelines and processes. Resolve team challenges and monitor performance through KPIs to meet targets.

  • Customer Grievance Resolution Address and resolve RC-related issues efficiently, acting as the escalation point. Implement solutions to prevent recurring problems and improve overall process efficiency.

  • Data-Driven Reporting Generate and analyse daily MIS reports for senior management. Maintain accurate records and derive insights for process improvements.

  • Disbursal & Process Optimization Track vehicle disbursals to ensure timely RC transfers. Maintain detailed trackers and identify opportunities for process enhancement.

  • Regulatory Compliance Verify documentation accuracy and ensure compliance with RTO regulations. Conduct audits to maintain data integrity and legal adherence.

Who are we looking for?

  • Educational Background: Relevant degree or equivalent experience in a related field.

  • Skills and Tools: Proven leadership and ownership capabilities. Expertise in RTO operations, RC transfer processes, and RTO regulations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and tracking. Skilled in managing reconciliations and ensuring numerical accuracy. Strong communication skills for effective collaboration across teams.

  • Creative Aptitude: Analytical mindset to optimize processes and solve issues with a solution-focused approach.

  • Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in documentation and process compliance.

jobDescription:
Join Us as a Car Advisor (Sales Associate)
Do you get excited every time you see a great car? Do you enjoy talking to people, building relationships, and helping customers make important decisions?

Whether you're a car enthusiast, a people person, or someone looking to build a rewarding career in sales, CARS24 is the place for you!

Who Can Apply?
Men & Women passionate about cars and customer service
Freshers with confidence and enthusiasm
Individuals who enjoy interacting with customers and delivering exceptional experiences

What You'll Do
Be the Face of CARS24
Welcome and engage customers visiting our retail showrooms.
Understand customer requirements and help them find their perfect car.
Drive Sales Success
Guide customers through the complete car-buying journey.
Build trust and create a transparent, hassle-free buying experience.
Bring Cars to Life
Conduct exciting test drives and showcase vehicle features.
Share insights on vehicle specifications, benefits, and pricing.
Help Customers Own Their Dream Car
Explain financing and payment options.
Support customers with documentation and purchase formalities.
Build Lasting Relationships
Follow up with customers and create memorable experiences that drive referrals and repeat business.

What We're Looking For
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Customer-first mindset and positive attitude
Passion for cars and the automotive industry
Confidence in sales, negotiation, and relationship building
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Valid driving license preferred

What's In It For You?
✨ Attractive Salary
✨ Professional Training & Development
✨ Fast-Track Career Growth Opportunities
✨ Opportunity to Work with India's Leading Auto-Tech Company
✨ Dynamic, High-Energy Work Environment
✨ Learn, Grow, and Build a Long-Term Career in Automotive Retail

If cars excite you, customers inspire you, and success motivates you, we would love to meet you!

title: Builder - Customer Experience Partner
jobDescription:
Job Description Template Not FoWhat will you drive?
  • Supervise and manage daily Business-As-Usual (BAU) tasks within the customer support team.
  • Ensure smooth workflow and consistent delivery of service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Oversee preparation and analysis of daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as NPS, CSAT, D-SAT, and TAT.
  • Handle customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.
  • Track high-priority cases across RBI, SMT, Social Media, NCH, and ensure closure with thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Conduct regular reviews and provide coaching and feedback for performance improvement.
  • Support in the closure of regulatory and high-priority complaints.
  • Ensure accurate and timely responses to complaints received via RBI, social media, or any public platform.
  • Liaise with cross-functional teams (Product, Tech, Legal, Fin Ops, Ops, etc.) to resolve complex or high-impact customer cases.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
Who are we looking for?
  • Graduate with 3–5 years of experience in customer service or experience, with at least 1–2 years in a team lead role.
  • Prior experience handling regulatory complaints (RBI, NCH, etc.) and creating RCA's.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and escalations.
  • Proficiency in using CRM tools, ticketing systems, and MS Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with a focus on quality and compliance.

title: Builder - DCF Partner
jobDescription:
What will you drive?
As a Builder - Dealer Consumer Financing Partner , you will be the key link between the company and our network of dealers. You'll drive growth by:
  • Building and nurturing strong, long-term relationships with both new and existing dealers
  • Understanding dealer needs and delivering customized solutions that align with our offerings
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to dealers—guiding them through CARS24's products, services, and processes
  • Ensuring high levels of dealer satisfaction and engagement through regular interactions
  • Executing retention strategies that boost loyalty and increase transaction volumes
  • Identifying and tapping into cross-selling opportunities based on dealer profiles
  • Consistently achieving monthly targets related to dealer retention and business transactions
Who are we looking for?
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Have excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Possess a strong problem-solving mindset with a dealer-first attitude
  • Are proactive, target-oriented, and capable of managing multiple relationships efficiently
  • Understand the automotive ecosystem (preferred, but not mandatory)
  • Have a passion for delivering value and exceeding expectations

jobDescription:
Job Description – Telecaller

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and customer-focused Telecaller to engage with customers, understand their requirements, and drive sales through effective communication. The ideal candidate should possess strong interpersonal skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to convert inquiries into successful business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Sales

* Connect with customers through inbound and outbound calls to understand their requirements.
* Provide accurate information about products and services and guide customers toward suitable purchase decisions.
* Convert customer inquiries into sales opportunities through effective communication and persuasion.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling to maximize revenue.

Customer Experience

* Deliver a seamless and positive customer experience during every interaction.
* Address customer queries, concerns, and objections professionally and efficiently.
* Build strong customer relationships to encourage repeat business and referrals.
Call Management & Operations

* Manage high call volumes while maintaining service quality and productivity standards.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, follow-ups, and sales outcomes.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and achievement of daily targets.

Product Knowledge

* Develop and maintain strong knowledge of automobiles, products, and services.
* Stay updated on ongoing offers, promotions, and company processes.
* Effectively communicate product benefits and features to customers.

Requirements

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Outbound Sales, Inbound Sales, Telecalling, Upselling, Customer Service, or a related role.
* Undergraduate or Graduate (candidate should not be currently pursuing regular education).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle customer objections and close sales opportunities.
* Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving abilities.
* Comfortable working in a target-driven and performance-focused environment.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with CRM systems is preferred.

Language Requirements

* Fluency in English and Hindi is mandatory.
* Proficiency in the local/regional language is preferred.

Shift Details

* Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
* Week Off: One weekday off

Preferred Skills

* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple customer interactions.
* Positive attitude, adaptability, and willingness to learn.
* Interest or knowledge in the automobile industry will be an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a fast-growing and dynamic environment.
* Performance-driven incentives and growth opportunities.
* Continuous learning and career development.
* Collaborative and customer-centric work culture.

title: Builder - Finance
jobDescription:
What drives us?
A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at CARS24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?
  • P&L Management: Lead the management and analysis of the P&L statement, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with financial objectives and targets.
  • Business Partnering: Collaborate closely with business units and department heads to provide financial insights, analysis, and support for decision-making. Act as a strategic partner in driving business growth and profitability.

title: Builder - Underwriting Partner
jobDescription:
Credit underwriter



What will you drive?
  • Check complete files (KYC, Income & Financial Documents, Bank Statements) CIBIL and raise queries if there are some documents missing which are required as per policy for Loan appraisal.
  • Handling complete login process.
  • Personal Discussions (PD) with Borrowers and Recommendation for Loan Sanction.
  • Downloading and analyzing Credit Bureau History; analyses financial and bank statements of the prospective.
  • Analysis the File of SENP, SEP, PARTNERSHIP and Company Files (Pvt. Ltd and Public Limited).
  • Preparation of Monthly MIS.
  • Responsible for reprocess of reject cases.
  • MIS coordinator between Branch credit and HO Credit.


Who are we looking for?
  • Graduate from any recognized university (no preference for stream)
  • 2+ years of Credit Underwriting experience in AL, PL, BL, LAP/HL etc.
  • Decent understanding of various credit parameters like Cibil checking, FOIR, Banking understanding along with calculation of Average Quarterly balance, TVR/PD with customer and preparing relevant Credit Note.
  • Basic knowledge of working of MS Office, Google Sheets etc.

title: Builder - Telecalling Inspection
jobDescription:
What drives us?

We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Follow-Up on Lost Leads: Effectively communicate the benefits of our services, share promotional offers, and address customer concerns or objections.
  • Use CRM and lead management systems to monitor interactions and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Booking Appointments: Schedule car checkups, capturing accurate details such as vehicle model and preferred time.
  • Coordination with Footfall Team:
    • Work with the Footfall Team to confirm available time slots and ensure the customer is booked for the correct service.
    • Send appointment reminders to customers to ensure they are prepared and attend their scheduled checkups.
    • Collaborate with the Footfall Team to ensure seamless scheduling and coordination, sharing customer information and appointment details as needed.
  • Customer Relationship Building: Build positive, professional relationships with potential customers by providing excellent phone support and service.
  • Data Management & Reporting:
    • Maintain precise, up-to-date records of customer interactions, leads, and appointments within the CRM system.
    • Provide regular reports to management on call outcomes, appointment success, and lead conversion performance.

Who are we looking for?

  • Proven track record in telecalling, sales, or customer service, ideally within the automotive or service industries.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems or lead management tools is highly preferred.
  • Exceptional verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage leads in a professional and effective manner.
  • Strong objection handling abilities, with a knack for offering solutions or incentives to convert leads into confirmed appointments.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple leads, appointments, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Capacity to work efficiently and meet performance targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • A customer-centric approach with the ability to build rapport and maintain a friendly, professional demeanor throughout customer interactions.
  • Skilled at understanding customer needs and providing tailored solutions to meet them.
  • Comfortable using digital tools, CRM systems, and other relevant software for managing leads and appointments.
  • Knowledge of the automotive industry or experience working in car service/maintenance sectors is a plus.
  • Previous experience handling lost leads or appointment scheduling would be beneficial.

jobDescription:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven and customer-focused Program Manager to lead and manage end-to-end operations for Value Added Services (VAS). The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving customer satisfaction, optimizing operational processes, managing partner relationships, and ensuring business growth through efficient execution and continuous improvement initiatives.

## Key Responsibilities

### Operations & Customer Experience

* Manage end-to-end fulfillment of Value Added Services (VAS) and ensure seamless customer experience.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and provide high-quality post-sales support.
* Monitor service quality and implement process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction.

### Stakeholder & Partner Management

* Coordinate with external vendors, insurance partners, and service providers to ensure smooth operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive alignment between business objectives and partner deliverables.

### Program & Process Management

* Work closely with Product and Technology teams to improve customer journeys, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
* Identify process gaps and implement scalable solutions to improve performance.
* Lead cross-functional projects and ensure timely execution of key initiatives.

### Revenue & Growth

* Manage and scale post-delivery telesales operations to drive customer conversions and revenue growth.
* Develop strategies to improve upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Value Added Services.
* Track performance metrics and implement action plans to achieve business targets.

### Team Management

* Build, mentor, and manage high-performing teams.
* Set clear goals, monitor performance, and drive accountability across the team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

## Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in Program Management, Operations, Customer Success, Telesales, or related functions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in managing customer-facing operations and performance-driven teams.
* Ability to work with data, track KPIs, and drive business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

## Preferred Skills

* Experience in the automobile, insurance, fintech, or consumer-tech industry.
* Exposure to telesales operations, customer lifecycle management, and partner management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting dashboards.

## What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on high-impact business initiatives.
* Fast-paced learning environment with significant ownership.
* Career growth opportunities in a rapidly scaling organization.
* Collaborative and innovative work culture.

jobDescription:
We are looking for a hands-on intern or junior engineer to support development and production debugging for our finance middleware and agent workflows. The role involves working with APIs, databases, payloads, logs, automation scripts, and backend services. They will help investigate issues, validate data flows, build small tools, write fixes, and support ongoing dev tasks across middleware, integrations, and agent-based systems.

Key Responsibilities
- Debug API, payload, database, and log-related issues across middleware services.
- Support dev tasks in backend services, automation scripts, and internal tools.
- Inspect request/response payloads and trace business transactions through async flows.
- Write and run SQL queries to validate data, identify mismatches, and summarize findings.
- Use Postman, logs, Git, and local tooling to reproduce and investigate issues.
- Help with data cleanup, CSV/Excel analysis, scraping or ingestion scripts when needed.
- Assist with agent/MEC-related workflows involving Python, APIs, validation, and structured outputs.
- Document findings clearly for team members and stakeholders.
- Work with Git/Git Hub for code changes, reviews, and issue tracking.

Required Skills
- Strong programming fundamentals in Python, with ability to write clean scripts, debug issues, and work with APIs and data payloads.
- Working knowledge of REST APIs and JSON payloads.
- SQL basics: joins, filters, aggregations, debugging data issues.
- Familiarity with Git/Git Hub.
- Ability to read logs and reason through failures step by step.
- Exposure to Python backend frameworks such as Fast API, Flask, or Django is a plus.
- Experience with Postgre SQL, My SQL, Mongo DB, or SQLite is a plus.
- Experience with Postman/API testing is a plus.
- Exposure to AWS, Docker, CI/CD, Git Hub Actions, or cloud deployment is a plus.
- Data analysis experience using Pandas, Excel, Power BI, or Tableau is a plus.
- Web scraping or automation experience with Playwright, Selenium, Beautiful Soup, or Requests is a plus.
- Exposure to LLMs, agent workflows, Lang Chain, Open AI APIs, or multi-agent systems is a plus.
- Strong ownership, clear communication, and willingness to work on both dev and support tasks.

  • Experience in consumer tech, fintech, marketplace, lending, Saa S, or auto-tech preferred
Good to Have:
Experience with AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, recommendation systems, or customer journey automation.

title: Builder - Retail Associate (Luxury Vertical)
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What will you drive?

  • As a Builder - Retail Associate (RA) for Luxury car vertical, your daily goal is to reach a set number of leads and engage prospects with charm and persuasion.

  • We'll track your calling minutes to ensure every moment counts toward our success.

  • This role isn't just about showing up; it's about delivering results!

  • You'll have monthly targets that push your competitive spirit and test your negotiation skills. And there's more! You'll receive comprehensive training over 7 to 15 days, both in the classroom and on the job.

  • Our top-notch program prepares you to handle any challenge because at Cars24, we're committed to setting you up for success.

  • Get ready for incentives that revolve around hitting targets, scoring big on conversions, and turning every challenge into a victory lap. It's not just about meeting goals; it's about surpassing them and reaping the rewards.

Who are we looking for?

  • Cruise into a full-time gig with 6 action-packed work days a week.

  • Don't worry; we've got your back with a weekday off to recharge those engines.

  • A disciplined enthusiast with strong negotiation skills with customers and regular follow up to win back leads.

  • Park yourself at our office by 10 AM sharp (maximum), with a dash of Punctuality and flexibility for those occasional extra laps around the track.

  • Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cars24, where every day is a drive towards success!

title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities

Build and deploy Machine Learning models for business use cases.
Analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights.
Develop predictive models, recommendation systems, and forecasting solutions.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product teams.
Optimize model performance and support production deployments.

Required Skills

Strong Python and SQL skills.
Experience with Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with Tensor Flow or Py Torch.
Good understanding of ML algorithms, statistics, and data modeling.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus.
Exposure to Generative AI/LLMs is preferred.

title: Builder - LOS Recovery Partner
jobDescription:

  • Achieve daily and weekly collection targets.
  • Resolve delinquency across assigned cities, bucket-wise and DPD-wise.

  • Comfortable travelling within the assigned area.

title: Builder - Home Inspection
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • ⁠At Cars24, the Appointment-to-Inspection (A2I) journey is where customer trust is won or lost. Every on-time arrival, transparent inspection, and seamless interaction shapes the customer's experience and fuels our growth. We're building an A2I function that is operationally resilient, customer-centric, and obsessed with delivering excellence at scale.

  • Own the A2I customer experience, reducing escalations by solving root causes—not just closing tickets.

  • ⁠Lead critical incident management, driving P0 response across customer and CJ-facing platforms with speed, accountability, and zero repeat failures.

  • ⁠Build a world-class CJ lifecycle, owning hiring, onboarding, training, engagement, payouts, and retention from Day 0 to steady state.

  • Design scalable operating mechanisms for escalation management, SLA governance, incident response, and continuous process improvement.

  • Partner across Product, Tech, HR, Finance, Customer Support, and Field Operations to eliminate friction and improve frontline execution.

  • ⁠Drive operational excellence through data-led decision making, structured problem solving, and robust governance.

  • ⁠Ensure field readiness by maintaining uninterrupted availability of CJ tools, uniforms, and operational resources across all cities.


Who are we looking for?

  • ⁠5 - 10 years of experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Field Operations, or Marketplace/Gig Economy businesses.

  • ⁠Proven track record of managing large, distributed frontline workforces and driving operational excellence at scale.

  • ⁠Strong experience in customer experience, incident management, or field operations with a bias for ownership.

  • ⁠Exceptional problem-solving skills with a root-cause-first mindset and ability to thrive in high-pressure environments.

  • ⁠Data-driven decision maker with exposure to operational dashboards; SQL is a plus.

  • ⁠Outstanding stakeholder management with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without authority.

  • ⁠High ownership, execution rigor, and willingness to travel across regional hubs.

title: Builder
jobDescription:
Great products are powered by backend systems that are reliable, scalable, and built to handle complexity. We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving hard problems, building from first principles, and shipping systems that scale.

This isn't a role where you'll just write APIs.
This is a builder role for someone who wants to design systems, improve architecture, and own services end-to-end.

What You'll Own
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and distributed systems.
Develop robust APIs and microservices that power critical business workflows.
Optimize system performance, reliability, and availability.
Build resilient architectures capable of handling high traffic and large-scale data.
Work closely with Product, Frontend, Data, and Infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Identify bottlenecks, debug production issues, and implement long-term fixes.
Drive engineering best practices around code quality, testing, observability, and deployment.

We're Looking For
2–6 years of experience in Backend Engineering.
Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Java, Go, Python, or Node.js.
Solid understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Design.
Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of SQL/No SQL databases, caching, and messaging systems.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerized deployments is a plus.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern engineering practices.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design skills.
Ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

title: Senior Manager
jobDescription:
We're looking for a finance professional who thrives on building strong financial controls, ensuring compliance, and driving accurate financial reporting. This role requires someone who can partner with business teams, improve processes, and enable data-driven decision-making while maintaining the highest standards of governance.

What You'll Own

  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close process.
  • Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  • Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records.
  • Strengthen financial controls and governance across business processes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve finance operations and drive process automation.
  • Manage statutory, tax, and internal audits, ensuring timely closure of audit observations.
  • Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and resolve accounting discrepancies.
  • Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial risks.
  • Drive compliance with accounting policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control frameworks.
  • Provide financial insights and variance analysis to support business decisions.

We're Looking For

  • CA qualified (preferred) with 5–10 years of experience in Financial Controllership, Accounting, or Audit.
  • Strong knowledge of Ind AS/IFRS, financial reporting, and accounting principles.
  • Experience managing statutory audits, internal audits, and tax compliance.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Net Suite, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on accuracy and compliance.
  • Ability to simplify complex accounting issues and drive scalable solutions.
  • Experience in process improvement and finance automation.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and influence stakeholders across the organization.

📍 Location: Gurugram

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We're building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.

What Will You Drive?
  • Establish and optimize Retail C2C unit processes, managing daily team performance.
  • The incumbent is responsible for setting up the Retail unit and processes, managing daily performance of all team members and delivering regular reviews.
  • Develop and implement sales strategies and goals.
  • Monitor performance and provide feedback to improve results.
  • Collaborate with operations, loan team, VAS team to optimize sales efforts.
  • Achieve targeted growth at a rate and margin consistent with the company's business plan.

Who are we looking for?
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage diverse teams.
  • In-depth knowledge of retail operations, sales strategies, and customer experience management.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to engage with teams and senior leadership.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze and leverage metrics for business improvement.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

title: Content Writer
jobDescription:
Key responsibilities

  • Create engaging content for websites, blogs, landing pages, emails, social media, campaigns, and product communication.
  • Develop informative and customer-friendly content related to cars, automotive trends, car buying, selling, financing, and ownership.
  • Write compelling headlines, campaign copies, advertisements, notifications, and promotional content.
  • Conduct research on automotive industry trends, customer behaviour, competitors, and relevant topics.
  • Optimise website and blog content using SEO best practices and relevant keywords.
  • Maintain consistency in brand tone, language, and messaging across all communication channels.
  • Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, clarity, grammar, and readability.
  • Collaborate with designers, marketers, product managers, and other stakeholders to execute content requirements.
  • Manage multiple content projects while meeting timelines and quality standards.
  • Update and improve existing content based on performance data, business requirements, and customer feedback.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience in content writing, copywriting, or content marketing.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong command of grammar, vocabulary, storytelling, and content structure.
  • Ability to simplify complex information into clear and engaging content.
  • Understanding of SEO, keyword research, and digital content best practices.
  • Ability to adapt writing style for different audiences and platforms.
  • Strong research, proofreading, and editing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong portfolio of published articles, blogs, website content, or campaign copies.
