title: Builder - Yard Ops
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Manage vehicle receiving, parking, movement, staging, and dispatch.

  • ⁠Optimize yard capacity and ensure SLA adherence.

  • ⁠Coordinate with transporters, vendors, drivers, and internal teams.

  • ⁠Monitor TATs, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain inventory accuracy.

  • ⁠Ensure yard safety, SOP compliance, and operational discipline.

  • Lead ground teams to drive productivity and execution.

  • ⁠Verify and manage RCs, insurance, invoices, gate passes, NOCs, and other statutory documents.

  • ⁠Maintain accurate digital and physical records with audit readiness.

  • Track documentation SLAs and resolve discrepancies proactively.

  • ⁠Monitor KPIs, prepare MIS reports, and identify process improvements.

  • ⁠Escalate critical operational issues and support cross-functional initiatives.


Who are we looking for?

  • Professionals who excel in fast-paced operations, take ownership, and deliver operational excellence with precision and accountability.

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.

  • ⁠1 - 10 years of experience in Yard Operations, Logistics, Fleet, Warehouse, Supply Chain, or Documentation.

  • Knowledge of vehicle documentation and statutory compliance is preferred.

  • ⁠Proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, and operational systems.

  • ⁠Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • ⁠High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and willingness to work in rotational shifts.

title: Builder - Apprentice
jobDescription:
What You'll Do

  • Analyze structured and unstructured data to derive actionable business insights.
  • Build, train, and evaluate Machine Learning models for real-world use cases.
  • Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Write efficient SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from large datasets.
  • Develop AI-powered solutions using techniques such as NLP, LLMs, Computer Vision, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where applicable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve business problems using data-driven approaches.
  • Present findings, document experiments, and contribute to model improvement and deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • B.Tech students from Tier 1 or Tier 2 engineering colleges.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of Machine Learning and Data Science fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with projects involving AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science.
  • Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn, and exposure to Tensor Flow/Py Torch is a plus.
  • Exposure to LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, RAG, Lang Chain, or similar AI technologies is preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and communication skills.
  • A Git Hub portfolio, Kaggle profile, hackathon participation, or research work will be an added advantage.

title: Builder - Hub Ops
jobDescription:
At CARS24, we're building a one-stop solution for all car ownership needs. Our mission is to make car ownership simple, convenient, and stress-free through technology and exceptional customer experience. As one of the world's largest Auto-tech companies, we're on a mission to grow 10x in the next five years.

Key Responsibilities
Manage daily yard operations and ensure proper vehicle placement.
Maintain cleanliness, safety, and housekeeping standards across the yard.
Coordinate vehicle movement, parking, and inventory management.
Conduct regular inspections of vehicles and yard conditions.
Maintain accurate vehicle records and inventory data using Excel.
Support operational teams with on-demand tasks and coordination activities.
Ensure smooth inflow and outflow of vehicles while maintaining process compliance.
Who Are We Looking For?
Graduate/Diploma holder with 0–2 years of experience in operations, logistics, yard management, or related roles.
Basic knowledge of vehicle handling and inventory management.
Proficiency in MS Excel and data entry.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks.
Responsible, proactive, and team-oriented approach.
Why Join CARS24?
Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Auto-tech companies.
Dynamic and growth-oriented work environment.
Learning and career development opportunities.

Job Title: Associate Architect – Retail Store Design

Location: Gurgaon | Work for office | 5 days a week

Department: Retail Expansion & Store Design

Reports To: Design Lead – Retail Stores


Job Summary:

Cars24 is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Associate Architect to support the design and execution of

our retail store projects. In this role, you will collaborate with the Design Lead to develop store layouts, create

technical drawings and 3D models, and ensure seamless execution of retail spaces that enhance customer

experience. This is a great opportunity to contribute to innovative retail store concepts while working in a

fast-paced, dynamic environment.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in developing store layouts, space planning, and technical drawings for new and existing
  • retail locations.
  • Create 3D models, renderings, and mood boards to visualize design concepts.
  • Work closely with the Design Lead to transform creative ideas into practical, buildable solutions.
  • Collaborate with vendors, contractors, and project teams to ensure design feasibility and execution
  • within set timelines.
  • Conduct site visits to oversee store fit-outs, assess construction progress, and resolve design-related
  • challenges.
  • Research and integrate new materials, finishes, and retail design trends to enhance store aesthetics
  • and functionality.
  • Ensure all designs align with brand guidelines, budget constraints, and operational requirements.
  • Support in presentation development and coordination with cross-functional teams.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Retail Design, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in retail, commercial, or interior architecture.
  • Proficiency in Auto CAD, Sketch Up, Vray, Enscape and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator,
  • In Design).
  • Strong understanding of materials, lighting, fixture design, and visual merchandising principles.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring attention to detail and quality.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external
  • stakeholders.

Preferred:

  • Experience in retail, showroom, or experiential store design.
  • Knowledge of innovative design solutions and understanding for retail spaces.


Why Join Us?

  • Be a part of an exciting retail expansion journey with innovative store concepts.
  • Gain hands-on experience in end-to-end retail design execution.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

title: Builder - Marketing
jobDescription:
Job Title: Tamil Content Creator – CARS24 Tamil (You Tube)

Location: Gurgaon (Hybrid) / Remote (for the right candidate)

About the Role

We're looking for a Tamil Content Creator to build and grow the CARS24 Tamil You Tube channel. You'll be responsible for creating engaging automotive content for a Tamil-speaking audience—from ideation to on-camera presentation.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about cars, understands You Tube, and can simplify complex automotive topics into entertaining, informative videos.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research and identify trending automotive topics relevant to the Tamil audience.
  • Write engaging scripts in Tamil.
  • Host videos confidently on camera.
  • Plan and execute shoots with the production team.
  • Work with editors to ensure high-quality final videos.
  • Develop You Tube-friendly titles, thumbnails, and content packaging.
  • Analyze video performance and continuously improve content strategy.
  • Stay updated on the latest automotive news, launches, regulations, and industry trends.
  • Build a consistent content calendar and help scale the channel.

Required Skills

  • Native or fluent Tamil speaker with excellent written and spoken communication.
  • Strong understanding of automobiles and the Indian automotive market.
  • Comfortable speaking on camera with a natural, engaging personality.
  • Experience in scriptwriting for You Tube or digital content.
  • Strong storytelling and audience retention skills.
  • Good understanding of You Tube SEO, thumbnails, CTR, audience retention, and analytics.
  • Ability to research topics quickly and verify information.
  • Basic understanding of video production and editing workflows.
  • Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience in content creation, You Tube, journalism, or digital media.
  • Experience running or contributing to a You Tube channel.
  • Familiarity with Premiere Pro or other editing software is a plus.
  • Photography/videography experience is an added advantage.
  • Valid driving license and willingness to drive/test vehicles for shoots.

What We're Looking For

  • Passion for cars and automotive storytelling.
  • Strong camera presence and communication skills.
  • Creativity backed by data-driven decision making.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a fast-paced content team.
  • A deep understanding of Tamil audiences and internet culture.

Bonus Points If You:

  • Already run a You Tube, Instagram, or Facebook page focused on automobiles.
  • Have experience reviewing cars, explaining automotive technology, or covering automotive news.
  • Understand what makes videos go viral and can consistently generate high-impact content ideas.

title: Intern
jobDescription:
Finance Product & Transformation Manager:

Great finance systems are not built by writing requirements and waiting for tech to deliver. They are built by people who understand the business journey end-to-end, can translate it into system logic, and can push execution through ambiguity.
I am looking for someone to join my team in Finance Transformation at CARS24 — someone who can operate at the intersection of Finance, Product, Tech, Ops, and Business.

This is not a traditional finance role.
This is not a pure product role either.
This is a builder role for someone who can design and execute finance automation journeys.

What you'll own:
→ Finance automation across businesses — build and drive finance transaction automation across India and international businesses, covering sales, purchase, payments, collections, refunds, and related finance workflows.
→ System-to-system finance journeys — understand how business events flow across source systems, APIs, middleware, accounting systems, reconciliations, and reporting.
→ Finance process design — convert unstructured business and finance requirements into clear workflows, FRDs, accounting logic, exception handling, and UAT plans.
→ Fallout resolution — identify transaction failures, root causes, reconciliation breaks, missing entries, incorrect postings, and build permanent fixes instead of manual patches.
→ Cross-functional execution — work with Finance, Product, Tech, Ops, and Business teams to move projects from ambiguity to shipped outcomes.
→ Controls and scalability — ensure automation is not just fast, but accurate, auditable, controlled, and scalable across geographies and business lines.
Who I'm looking for:
→ 2-3 years of experience in Finance Transformation, Product Ops, Program Management, Finance Systems, ERP implementation, fintech operations, or business analyst roles.
→ Strong ownership mindset — someone who does not wait for perfectly structured requirements and can create clarity where there is none.
→ Comfortable with ambiguity — able to build the first version, align stakeholders, course-correct, and keep execution moving.
→ Product/system thinking — understands APIs, system workflows, payloads, statuses, failure scenarios, dashboards, and exception handling.
→ Finance understanding — knows basic accounting, reconciliations, controls, financial reporting impact, and why accuracy matters.
→ Execution-first approach — can run trackers, chase blockers, conduct UAT, close open items, and drive timelines without needing constant supervision.
→ Bonus: experience in SAP HANA, middleware, SQL, Python, or startup finance automation.
Why this role?
You will work on high-impact finance automation initiatives across CARS24's India and international businesses.
The mandate is simple but powerful:
Every valid business transaction should flow into finance systems accurately, completely, and with minimal manual intervention.

title: Builder - Apprentice
jobDescription:
What You'll Do

  • Analyze structured and unstructured data to derive actionable business insights.
  • Build, train, and evaluate Machine Learning models for real-world use cases.
  • Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Write efficient SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from large datasets.
  • Develop AI-powered solutions using techniques such as NLP, LLMs, Computer Vision, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where applicable.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve business problems using data-driven approaches.
  • Present findings, document experiments, and contribute to model improvement and deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • B.Tech students from Tier 1 or Tier 2 engineering colleges.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Solid understanding of Machine Learning and Data Science fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with projects involving AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science.
  • Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn, and exposure to Tensor Flow/Py Torch is a plus.
  • Exposure to LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, RAG, Lang Chain, or similar AI technologies is preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and communication skills.
  • A Git Hub portfolio, Kaggle profile, hackathon participation, or research work will be an added advantage.

title: Builder - Customer Experience
jobDescription:
JD - Customer Experience Associate

What will you drive ?

Take full ownership of critical escalations and ensure 100% closure within defined timelines.
Maintain a consistent workflow to meet and exceed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Turnaround Time (TAT) targets for complex cases.
Conduct deep-dive investigations into recurring issues to identify process gaps and recommend long-term fixes to the Product and Tech teams.
Draft and deliver accurate, professional, and timely responses to complaints on public platforms and regulatory portals, ensuring alignment with legal standards.
Directly impact organizational health by improving key performance indicators, specifically NPS (Net Promoter Score) and CSAT, while minimizing D-SAT.
Liaise with Finance, Operations, and Legal teams to resolve high-impact cases that require multi-departmental input.
Actively identify friction points in the customer journey and propose actionable improvements to enhance operational efficiency.

Who we are looking for ?

Undergraduate/ Graduate with 1–4 years of experience in Customer Service/Experience, specifically in handling high-level escalations or regulatory portfolios.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to handle angry customers over calls and emails.
Proven ability to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and translate raw data into meaningful reports (Daily/Weekly/Monthly).
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations and difficult customers diplomatically.
Hands-on experience with CRM tools, ticketing systems, and advanced MS Excel/Google Sheets for reporting.
A customer-first attitude combined with a strong focus on quality, compliance, and detail.

title: Builder - People Experience
jobDescription:
About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented HR Payroll Executive to manage end-to-end payroll operations while ensuring accuracy, statutory compliance, and a seamless employee experience. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with HRMS/payroll systems and collaborating across HR, Finance, and employees.

What You'll Do

  • Process end-to-end monthly payroll for employees.
  • Ensure timely and accurate salary disbursement.
  • Manage payroll inputs including attendance, leave, incentives, reimbursements, overtime, and deductions.
  • Validate new joiners, exits, full & final settlements (F&F), and salary revisions.
  • Coordinate with Finance for payroll processing and statutory payments.
  • Ensure compliance with PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Gratuity, Bonus, and other statutory regulations.
  • Generate payroll reports, MIS, and reconciliation reports.
  • Resolve employee payroll-related queries within defined timelines.
  • Maintain payroll records while ensuring confidentiality of employee data.
  • Support payroll audits and statutory inspections.
  • Work closely with HR Operations to ensure employee data accuracy in the HRMS.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience in Payroll or HR Operations.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll software/HRMS (Darwinbox, SAP, Keka, Greyt HR, Oracle, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of Indian payroll regulations and labour compliances.
  • Knowledge of Income Tax, PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and payroll reconciliations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, formulas).
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.

title: Builder - Dealer Experience
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Maintain a dealer-centric approach at Cars24, where positivity, empathy, and professionalism are our driving forces.

  • Respond to dealer inquiries quicker than a revved-up engine, ensuring every query gets the attention it deserves.

  • Connect with dealers through all channels whether it's a call, email, or a friendly and exciting face-to-face chat, we've got you covered!

  • Swiftly acknowledge and resolve dealer complaints with the precision of a pit crew, turning frustrations into smiles.

  • Know our products inside and out, so you can answer questions faster than a speed demon on the racetrack.

  • Keep records of dealer interactions, transactions, and even the occasional complaint, because at Cars24, every detail matters.

  • Follow up with stakeholders like a pro, ensuring every issue and challenge gets resolved faster than a Formula 1 pit stop.

  • Provide feedback on our dealer service process because at Cars24, we're always looking for ways to rev up our performance.

  • Ensure dealer satisfaction and provide professional support, because at Cars24, happy dealers are our ultimate goal.

  • Keep daily operational tasks running smoother than a finely- tuned engine, with zero errors and maximum efficiency!


Who are we looking for?

  • Your verbal prowess will be the fuel that powers our conversations, turning inquiries into opportunities and connections into conversions.

  • And when it comes to organization, your attention to detail will be the secret ingredient that keeps our operations running smoother than a freshly waxed car.

title: CRM Specialist
jobDescription:
We are looking for a CRM Specialist to manage and optimize customer engagement through lifecycle marketing campaigns. You will execute CRM campaigns, improve customer retention, and drive engagement across Email, SMS, Whats App, Push Notifications, and other digital channels.
Key Responsibilities

Plan and execute CRM campaigns across multiple channels.
Build customer segments and automated lifecycle journeys.
Monitor campaign performance and optimize engagement and conversions.
Conduct A/B testing and analyze campaign results.
Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Design, and Analytics teams.
Maintain CRM data hygiene and prepare performance reports.
Requirements

2–5 years of experience in CRM/Lifecycle Marketing.
Hands-on experience with tools like Clever Tap, Mo Engage, Web Engage, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Hub Spot.
Strong analytical skills with Excel/SQL and campaign reporting.
Good understanding of customer lifecycle, segmentation, and marketing automation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Intern
jobDescription:
Job Title: Influencer Marketing Intern

Location:

Gurgaon (Hybrid/On-site)

Duration:

3–6 Months

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic Influencer Marketing Intern to support end-to-end influencer campaign execution across multiple business verticals. You will work closely with the Influencer Marketing team to identify creators, coordinate campaigns, manage content execution, and track campaign performance.

This role offers hands-on exposure to influencer marketing, digital campaigns, creator management, social media, and performance analytics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scout and identify relevant influencers across Instagram and You Tube based on campaign objectives.
  • Reach out to creators and support the onboarding process.
  • Coordinate with creators for scripts, campaign briefs, shoot schedules, and content delivery.
  • Track campaign timelines and maintain the posting calendar.
  • Conduct quality checks on content and coordinate feedback with creators.
  • Ensure timely publishing of campaign content across platforms.
  • Maintain campaign trackers and update creator databases.
  • Support payment processing and documentation for creators.
  • Monitor campaign performance, including views, engagement, leads, and other key metrics.
  • Assist in managing city-wise Instagram pages and content publishing.
  • Coordinate with internal teams including Growth, CRM, Operations, and Marketing for smooth campaign execution.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Good understanding of Instagram, You Tube, and influencer marketing.
  • Comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel.
  • Detail-oriented with good organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Basic analytical mindset and willingness to work with campaign data.

Good to Have

  • Prior internship in Digital Marketing or Social Media.
  • Experience managing creator collaborations.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools or project management tools.

What You'll Learn

  • End-to-end influencer marketing operations.
  • Campaign planning and execution.
  • Creator relationship management.
  • Performance marketing metrics (CPV, CPL, ROI, Engagement).
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Growth, CRM, and Operations teams.
  • Campaign reporting and performance analysis.

title: Builder - Underwriting Partner
jobDescription:
Supervise a team of credit executives for evaluating client's creditworthiness to approving or rejecting used car consumer loan requests and setting loan terms

Responsibilities will also include checking credit decision mismatch with scoring models created by Data Science and provide inputs to minimise credit DS mismatch

Continuous Credit Review to monitor used car loan portfolio and provide inputs after understanding root cause analysis of deteriorating cohorts in portfolio

Rejection analysis and achieving month-on-month approval targets

Maintaining TAT with accuracy in decision of used car loan cases

Managing relationships with partners (other peer financiers) and achieving max penetration with them to book cases with them as per aligned policies

Alignment of credit policy and processes with cross functional departments and all stakeholders

Responsible for handling Trade Advance, RC Limit for Dealers/DSA

Involvement in strategic planning and benchmarking of Credit Policy with Peers and making necessary changes as per market norms

· Post graduate from any recognised university(no preference for stream), CA / CFA / MBA in Banking and Finance or relevant field would be preferred.


· 4-6 years of experience in core underwriting


· Team handling experience


· Proven work experience as a Credit Manager, Credit Analyst or similar role


· Hands-on experience with TVR of customers and Fintech Credit Underwriting models


· Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to create and process financial spreadsheets (e.g. in Excel)


· Understanding of lending policy and procedures of retail loan products, preferably car / vehicle / personal loans for salaried and self employed customers with speed and accuracy

title: Builder - Dealer Experience Partner
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a team of Builder - Dealer Experience to deliver exceptional support, ensuring every dealer interaction reflects Cars24's commitment to service excellence.

  • Own day-to-day team operations by monitoring productivity, service quality, SLAs, and resolution timelines, ensuring a seamless dealer experience.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex dealer queries and grievances, driving timely and effective resolutions while maintaining strong dealer relationships.

  • Conduct regular quality audits, feedback sessions, and performance reviews to continuously improve team effectiveness and customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Operations, Product, Finance, and Tech to resolve dealer issues and remove operational bottlenecks.

  • Analyze operational metrics, identify trends, and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, reduce turnaround time, and improve dealer satisfaction.

  • Ensure accurate documentation of dealer interactions, escalations, and resolutions while maintaining high standards of data quality and process compliance.

  • Drive adherence to SOPs, operational policies, and service standards across the team while proactively identifying opportunities to improve them.

  • Mentor and develop team members through regular coaching, knowledge-sharing sessions, and performance improvement plans to build a high-performing team.

  • Prepare and present regular reports, operational insights, and action plans to leadership, ensuring transparency on team performance and key business metrics.

  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and high-energy work environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of the team's DNA.

  • Champion dealer satisfaction by ensuring every interaction strengthens trust, builds long-term relationships, and contributes to the growth of the Cars24 dealer ecosystem.


Who are we looking for?

  • A natural people leader who knows how to motivate, coach, and develop teams while driving high performance and accountability.

  • Someone with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of building strong relationships across dealers, internal teams, and leadership.

  • A problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, confidently handling escalations and making sound decisions under pressure.

  • A data driven professional who can interpret operational metrics, identify improvement opportunities, and translate insights into measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong process orientation with an eye for operational excellence, quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize work for both self and the team.

  • Comfortable working with CRM tools, spreadsheets, dashboards, and operational reporting systems to manage performance and drive informed decisions.

  • A collaborative leader who believes in teamwork, takes ownership, and inspires others to achieve common goals.

  • Someone who leads by example, demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and integrity, and consistently delivers an outstanding dealer experience.

  • Prior experience leading customer support, dealer support, customer experience, or operations teams will be an added advantage.

title: Builder
jobDescription:
We're looking for a hands-on technology leader who can build high-performing engineering teams, drive technical excellence, and deliver scalable products. You will work closely with Product, Design, Data, and Business teams to translate business goals into robust technology solutions while mentoring engineers and shaping the engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, providing technical guidance and career development.
Own end-to-end delivery of product features and engineering initiatives.
Drive engineering best practices, including architecture, code quality, testing, security, and performance.
Collaborate with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to define technical roadmaps and execution plans.
Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems capable of supporting rapid business growth.
Review system architecture, conduct design reviews, and make key technical decisions.
Improve engineering productivity through automation, tooling, and streamlined development processes.
Hire, coach, and retain top engineering talent while fostering a high-performance culture.
Ensure timely project delivery with a strong focus on quality, scalability, and customer impact.
Monitor production systems, resolve critical issues, and drive continuous improvements.

What We're Looking For
5-8 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years leading engineering teams.
Strong expertise in backend technologies such as Java, Go, Python, or Node.js.
Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, APIs, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and databases.
Experience building and scaling high-traffic, production-grade applications.
Strong understanding of system design, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Dev Ops practices, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and observability tools.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Passion for mentoring engineers and building a strong engineering culture.

title: Builder - Telecalling Growth Yard
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Connect with customers from non-serviceable locations where doorstep inspection is unavailable.

  • Educate customers about the Store concept and invite them to bring their cars for inspection.

  • Coordinate with Car Evaluators for timely inspections at Stores.

  • Maintain and improve Store footfall ratio.

  • Build customer relationships through effective communication and follow-ups.

  • Achieve monthly calling, conversion, and footfall targets.

  • Participate in classroom and on-the-job training.

  • Earn performance-based incentives for achieving targets.


Who are we looking for?

  • Cruise into a full-time gig with 6 action-packed work days a week with 1 weekday off.

  • Don't worry; we've got your back with a weekday off to recharge those engines.

  • A disciplined enthusiast with strong negotiation skills with customers and regular follow up to win back leads.

  • Zoom in at 9:30 AM and coast through to 6:30 PM—because at Cars24, we're all about revving up during office hours.

  • Park yourself at our office by 10 AM sharp (maximum), with a dash of Punctuality and flexibility for those occasional extra laps around the track.


Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cars24, where every day is a drive towards success!

title: Builder - Soft Collections
jobDescription:
What will you drive ?
Make outbound calls to customers to remind and assist them with EMI payments. Consistently meet or exceed daily call and collection targets set by the team leader or manager. Ensure accurate and timely collection of any additional charges or fees associated with EMI payments. Clarify any customer queries related to charges, helping them understand the payment breakdown Build and maintain positive relationships with customers to foster trust and ensure continued engagement. Handle objections, resolve customer issues professionally, and negotiate effectively to achieve resolution. Maintain detailed and accurate call records, payment statuses, and customer interactions in the system. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines throughout the collection process.

Who are we looking for ?
Minimum 2+ years of experience in telecalling, preferably in EMI collections and recovery processes. Proven ability to convince and negotiate effectively with customers in a professional manner. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to handle challenging conversations with ease. Basic proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, for maintaining reports and analyzing data. Goal-oriented mindset with the ability to consistently meet and exceed targets. High level of patience, empathy, and professionalism while interacting with customers.

title: Builder - Quality Check
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Update and maintain the Hypothecation Panel with accurate loan-related information.

  • Review credit reports for hypothecated vehicles and identify any discrepancies.

  • ⁠Close loans on the admin panel based on confirmations received from vendors.

  • Verify the authenticity and completeness of NOCs (No Objection Certificate), LFCs (Loan Foreclosure Certificate), and other loan-related documents.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to align BBNP cases and approve them based on valid documentation.

  • Work closely with local operations teams for physical and digital document verification.

  • Track pending loan closures and documentation cases to ensure timely resolution.

  • Handle and resolve customer escalations related to loans, NOCs, and supporting documents.

  • Maintain accurate records and ensure adherence to defined operational processes and compliance standards.


Who are we looking for?

  • A graduate with experience in loan operations, banking operations, vehicle finance, or document verification.

  • Sound understanding of hypothecation, loan closure, NOCs, LFCs, credit reports, and vehicle documentation.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify document discrepancies or fraudulent submissions.

  • Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, customers, and internal operations teams.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage escalations and time-sensitive cases.

  • Comfortable working with admin panels, Excel, Google Sheets, and operational tracking tools.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and process compliance.


Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cars24, where every day is a drive towards success!

title: Builder - Apprentice (Logistics Team)
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • Analyse yard throughput, vehicle dwell time and workflow bottlenecks, and recommend interventions to improve operational performance.

  • Evaluate interstate vehicle movement and towing data to identify cost leakages, process inefficiencies and vendor performance gaps.

  • ⁠Audit fuel consumption and driver payout cycles, identify anomalies and recommend improvements to strengthen unit economics.

  • Convert operational pain points into clear product specifications for internal tools and dashboards.

  • Map manual logistics workflows and support their transformation from spreadsheets to dashboards, automation and AI-enabled systems.

  • Build and test lightweight solutions using AI tools, Apps Script or no-code platforms before full-scale product development.

  • Work closely with Operations, Logistics, Product and Technology teams to translate insights into actionable outcomes.


Who are we looking for?

  • A recent graduate in Engineering, Economics, Business or another quantitative discipline.

  • Strong interest in operations, logistics, supply chain and solving complex real-world problems.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivots, lookups and formula-based analysis.

  • Working knowledge of SQL; exposure to Python or R will be an advantage.

  • Experience with dashboards such as Looker, Data Studio, Tableau or equivalent tools.

  • Familiarity with AI and automation tools such as Chat GPT, Claude, Cursor, Apps Script, Zapier or Retool.

  • Strong written and analytical communication skills, with the ability to convert complex findings into concise recommendations.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, high-ownership environments and engaging directly with on-ground teams.

  • A strong bias for action, experimentation and end-to-end execution.

We are looking for a Public Policy professional to help shape and execute our engagement with government stakeholders, regulatory bodies, and industry associations. The ideal candidate will monitor policy developments, analyze regulatory changes, build strategic relationships, and support advocacy efforts that align with the company's business objectives.

jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. title: Intern
jobDescription:
About the Role
We're looking for an AI-native Analytics Intern who thinks in data and works with AI tools as a natural extension of how they operate. You'll work closely with business and product teams to turn raw data into clear, actionable insights — using AI to move faster, automate the repetitive parts of analysis, and get to the "so what" quicker.

What You Will Do
  • Pull, clean and analyse data using SQL and Excel/Google Sheets to answer business questions from stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports (Tableau/Power BI/Looker) for real-time visibility into key metrics.
  • Use AI tools (Chat GPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, etc.) to speed up data exploration, write/debug SQL and Python, and automate repetitive analysis.
  • Partner with Product, Operations and Business teams to understand problems and translate data into recommendations.
  • Conduct ad-hoc deep-dives — funnel analysis, cohort analysis, trend analysis — to support decision-making.
  • Identify patterns, anomalies and opportunities in data proactively.
  • Document analysis clearly so findings are reusable for the team.
  • Explore new AI tools and workflows that make the analytics process faster or sharper.

What We're Looking For
  • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in a quantitative field — Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Math, Computer Science, or similar.
  • Genuinely AI-native — uses AI tools daily as part of how you think and work. Comfortable prompting, iterating, and critically evaluating AI outputs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL; basic Python (Pandas) is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets — pivot tables, formulas, basic modelling.
  • Strong problem-solving instincts — curious by default, asks "why" before jumping to "how."
  • Ability to communicate data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
  • Prior internship, project or self-driven data analysis work is a plus.

title: Builder - Apprentice
jobDescription:
About the Role

We're looking for a passionate Mobile Engineer to build high-quality, scalable, and user-centric mobile applications that power millions of user interactions. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and QA teams to deliver seamless mobile experiences while contributing to architectural decisions and engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance mobile applications.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable code following industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party SDKs.
  • Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
  • Write clean, testable, and well-documented code.
  • Debug production issues and ensure timely resolution.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards.
  • Stay updated with the latest mobile technologies, frameworks, and development practices.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to drive features end-to-end.
  • Passion for building delightful mobile experiences.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
  • Continuous learner who stays updated with emerging mobile technologies.

title: Builder - Program Management (Elite Team)
jobDescription:
What drives us?

A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years.


What will you drive?

  • SB Partner Automation: Build automated workflows for live reconciliation, partner communication, franchise lead visibility, channel-wise lead tracking, conversions, calling metrics, and inventory lead movement.

  • Access Management Automation: Create an end-to-end workflow for RA allocation, store and email ID creation, access provisioning, approvals, removals, and audit tracking.

  • Elite Incentive Tracker: Develop a live tracker to automate incentive calculations, monitor payout readiness, and provide real-time stakeholder visibility.

  • GS Pricing Engine: Build an AI- and data-led pricing engine for luxury and non-luxury procurement to enable faster, consistent, and governed pricing decisions.

  • Recon Master – FRS: Automate monthly reconciliation up to the pre-approval stage, covering pending actions, exceptions, partner communication, and closure tracking.

  • Partner with Product, Technology, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Category teams to drive implementation and adoption.

  • Define project milestones, success metrics, governance mechanisms, and process documentation.


Who are we looking for?

  • Experience in program management, business operations, automation, analytics, or digital transformation.

  • Strong ability to translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions.

  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, SQL, and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

  • Exposure to workflow automation, APIs, low-code platforms, AI, or pricing models is preferred.

  • Strong analytical, project-management, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

  • An ownership-driven professional with excellent problem-solving, communication, and execution skills.

title: Builder - Consumer Finance
jobDescription:
Builder – Telecalling Retail Partner

What Will You Drive?

As Builder – Telecalling Retail Partner, you will oversee and manage sales operations within your vertical. Your role involves strategizing and implementing initiatives to achieve revenue targets, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing team performance. You will work closely with stakeholders to streamline processes, optimize resources, and contribute to the overall growth of the sales function.

Who Are We Looking For?

A driven and result-oriented professional with proven expertise in sales operations. The ideal candidate should possess exceptional leadership, analytical, and communication skills, along with a track record of achieving and exceeding sales goals.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy and Execution

• Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve business objectives and revenue targets.

• Monitor sales performance metrics and implement corrective actions as needed.

Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and motivate the sales team to achieve individual and team goals.

• Conduct performance evaluations and identify training and development needs.

Customer Relationship Management

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners.

• Address customer queries and ensure a high level of satisfaction.

Process Optimization

• Streamline sales processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve bottlenecks and improve workflows.

Market Analysis and Reporting

• Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify opportunities.

• Generate regular reports on sales performance and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

Compliance and Documentation

• Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions.

Qualifications

• Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Master's degree is preferred.

• Experience: 5–7 years of experience in sales, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. Proven track record in managing sales operations and achieving targets.

• Skills: Strong knowledge of sales strategies, CRM tools, and reporting systems. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to analyze data, interpret trends, and make data-driven decisions.

title: Builder - Founders' Office
jobDescription:
Role Overview

Work directly with the Founder(s) to drive high-impact strategic initiatives, solve complex business problems, and execute cross-functional projects. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, and can seamlessly switch between strategy and execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with founders on strategic business initiatives and special projects.
  • Drive end-to-end execution of cross-functional projects across Product, Tech, Operations, Finance, and HR.
  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and business opportunity assessments.
  • Build dashboards, reports, business cases, and executive presentations.
  • Track key business metrics and provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of critical initiatives.
  • Identify process gaps and implement scalable solutions.
  • Support leadership with investor decks, board updates, and strategic planning when required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2–6 years of experience in Strategy, Consulting, Business Operations, Program Management, or a high-growth startup.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and Power Point.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • High ownership, bias for action, and attention to detail.
  • MBA from a premier institute is preferred but not mandatory

title: Builder
jobDescription:
About the Role

We're looking for an experienced SDE II - Backend to build scalable, high-performance backend systems that power mission-critical product experiences. You'll own backend services end-to-end, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs.
  • Build distributed, high-availability microservices with a focus on performance and reliability.
  • Optimize databases, caching, and application performance.
  • Participate in system design, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and drive continuous improvements.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of backend development experience in a product-based company.
  • Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python.
  • Solid understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, OOP, and System Design.
  • Hands-on experience with Microservices, REST APIs, SQL/No SQL databases, Redis, Kafka/Rabbit MQ, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture, Elasticsearch, or Terraform.
  • Exposure to high-scale consumer internet, marketplace, fintech, or mobility platforms.

jobDescription:
What drives us? A single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone
- from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we are building at CARS24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. We are building a one-stop shop, a Super App for all their car needs, powered by technology, data science, and deep customer insights. We are already one of the largest Auto-tech companies in the world, but we are not stopping here. We aim to grow 10x in the next five years. What will you drive? As a Quality Inspector at Cars24, you will be responsible for:
1. Thorough Vehicle Inspections: Conducting detailed evaluations of pre-owned vehicles, checking both exterior and interior conditions to ensure they meet Cars24's quality standards.
2. Quality Reporting: Documenting inspection findings, highlighting defects or damages, and recommending necessary repairs to maintain top-notch vehicle conditions.
3. Compliance Assurance: Verifying that all vehicles comply with regulatory safety standards and that paperwork related to inspection, service history, and repairs is accurate and complete.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working closely with technical, repair, and sales teams to address quality issues and ensure vehicles are accurately listed.
5. Process Improvement: Identifying areas for enhancement in the inspection process to boost efficiency and uphold quality standards.
6. Customer Satisfaction: Contributing to high customer satisfaction by ensuring only quality-inspected vehicles are sold Who are we looking for? We are looking for a Quality Inspector who has:
1. Attention to Detail: Strong observational skills to accurately assess the quality and condition of vehicles.
2. Technical Knowledge: Understanding of vehicle mechanics, electronics, and aesthetic standards for thorough inspections.
3. Analytical Skills: Ability to generate detailed, clear reports with actionable insights.
4. Collaborative Approach: Proven ability to work effectively with various teams, including technical and sales.

title: Builder - Regional Collections
jobDescription:
• Drive monthly collection targets across all assigned locations and portfolios.
  • Monitor delinquency buckets (FEMI, SEMI, TEMI, MOB, DPD, Roll Rates, etc.) and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor ACMs and Collection Managers to improve operational performance.
  • Review daily collection performance, productivity, and recovery trends.
  • Ensure timely allocation and optimization of agency and field resources.
  • Monitor agency performance, productivity, and compliance with SLAs.
  • Handle escalated customer grievances and ensure timely resolution.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Credit, Legal, Fraud, and Customer Support teams for issue resolution.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, governance calls, and regional business reviews.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory guidelines, internal SOPs, and compliance standards.
  • Analyze MIS reports to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Manage repossession, skip-tracing, recovery, settlement, and legal recovery cases as per company policy.
  • Drive process improvements and implement collection strategies to improve efficiency.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of regional collections teams.
  • Publish accurate MIS, dashboards, and management reports within defined timelines.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Collection Efficiency (%)
  • Roll Rate Control
  • DPD Reduction
  • Recovery Against Target
  • Agency Productivity
  • Resolution TAT
  • Skip Case Recovery
  • Compliance & Audit Scores
  • Portfolio Health
  • Customer Experience Metrics
Desired Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
  • 6–10+ years of experience in Collections/Recovery, preferably in Auto Finance, NBFC, or Banking.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience managing multiple locations or regions.
  • Strong analytical, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel, MIS reporting, and collection management systems.

  • Collections & Recovery Management
  • Portfolio Management
  • Team Leadership
  • Agency Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Negotiation & Conflict Resolution
  • Data Analysis & MIS
  • Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge
  • Problem Solving

title: Builder - People Experience
jobDescription:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and people-centric HR professional who can drive end-to-end HR operations while creating an exceptional employee experience. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, partnering with business leaders, and managing multiple HR functions simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, and exit processes.
  • Partner with hiring managers to ensure seamless recruitment coordination and timely closures.
  • Execute employee engagement initiatives, rewards & recognition programs, and culture-building activities.
  • Address employee queries and resolve concerns while maintaining a positive employee experience.
  • Ensure adherence to HR policies, processes, and organizational guidelines.
  • Coordinate performance management cycles, probation reviews, and employee development initiatives.
  • Maintain employee records and HR documentation with high accuracy and confidentiality.
  • Collaborate with Payroll, Finance, IT, and Admin teams for smooth HR operations.
  • Prepare HR reports, dashboards, and workforce analytics for leadership.
  • Support organizational restructuring, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.
  • Drive compliance with labor laws and statutory requirements.
  • Contribute to HR process improvements and automation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2–6 years of experience in Human Resources.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle management, and HR best practices.
  • Familiarity with HRMS platforms such as Darwinbox, Keka, Workday, SAP Success Factors, or similar.
